articles.title: Bitmine's Ethereum bet nears $9 billion loss as ether falls below $1,800
articles.snippet: Shares of Tom Lee's Ethereum treasury firm hit their lowest level since the company's crypto pivot as ETH revisits the February lows.

articles.title: Clarity Act survival depends on the U.S. Senate getting a lot of non-crypto work done
articles.snippet: The dwindling congressional calendar may spur a legislative competition for the crypto market structure bill to win Senate floor time against other priorities.

articles.title: Russian ruble stablecoin A7A5 grows despite Western sanctions: CertiK
articles.snippet: Russian ruble-backed stablecoin A7A5 processed over $110 billion in transactions despite Western sanctions, according to CertiK.

articles.title: Bitcoin's crash to $65K triggers $1.8B in crypto liquidations
articles.snippet: Bitcoin's drop to $65,000 triggered over $1.8 billion in crypto liquidations as traders brace for a test of $60,000 as support.

articles.title: US Treasury issues sanctions on Iran, targets 4 crypto exchanges
articles.snippet: The sanctions come four days after Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the US had seized nearly $1 billion in crypto from Iranian crypto exchanges and wallets since late February.
